name: public-cao-bennett-interface-recapitulation
hypothesis: AF2/RoseTTAFold2 consensus was within noise: most of its macro gain came from TrkA with five discovery positives, and IL7Ra lost PR-AUC. Test a distinct agreement criterion by averaging low AF2 interface error and low AF2/design complex RMSD. Confidence alone can support the wrong docking geometry; recapitulation of the designed complex may reject such cases. Equal normalized weights, no thresholds.
